scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved analytically; finite checker runs support but do not replace its proof. No claim of independent external verification, historical priority certification, or optimal sample complexity.
scientific_limitations: The population identity requires a fixed known threshold in the open interval (0,2) and labelled observations; the finite-sample guarantee requires independent replicates and a degree bound, is not claimed optimal, and does not cover arbitrary latent-weight distributions. Prior discovery is best-knowledge rather than exhaustive historical priority.
title: Covariance tomography for vertex-threshold random subgraphs
